subject: Audit rights & cross-border evidence request (DPA / Article 28/30 records)
content:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-energy.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit rights & cross-border evidence request (DPA / Article 28/30 records)

Hi Sonia,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Per our conversation, Acme asked for a short package to support your internal privacy review ahead of procurement sign-off. To keep things focused, we can provide the items below — we just want to confirm the scope you need so we don't over- or under-share.

Requested items we can provide today/tomorrow:
- Executed DPA (latest) — Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (attached)
- Subprocessors registry (current snapshot) — subprocessors_registry_2025-07.csv (attached)
- Article 28 / Article 30 records (processing activities summary) — gdpr_art28_30_records.xlsx (attached)
- Short DPIA summary and controls mapping — dpi_assessment_summary.pdf (attached)

A couple of quick clarifying Qs:
1) Audit rights: do you need on-site audit access, or will a third-party auditor report suffice (we typically provide independent auditor reports and scoped evidence; on-site audits are supported under structured procedures)?
2) Cross-border transfers: do you need SCCs + transfer impact assessment, or is a summary of transfer mechanisms & jurisdictions enough for your review?

If you confirm the audit approach and specific artifacts, we’ll route the final package through Legal and Compliance (cc'd) and raise a DocuSign envelope if required.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment stubs: [Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf] [subprocessors_registry_2025-07.csv] [gdpr_art28_30_records.xlsx] [dpi_assessment_summary.pdf]

---

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-energy.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-energy.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Audit rights & cross-border evidence request (DPA / Article 28/30 records)

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and for the attachments. High-level answers below so you can route what fits:

- Audit approach: Acme prefers an independent third-party auditor report (scope: SOC2 Type II or equivalent) plus a materials package of records for our review. We may request a scoped on-site review for critical suppliers later in the procurement process, but for now the auditor report + evidence is sufficient.
- Transfers: we need SCCs (or equivalent transfer mechanism) and a short transfer impact assessment explaining access from non-EEA regions. A list of subprocessors by country is helpful.
- DPIA: a short DPIA summary is fine; if there are any residual high-risk processing items, flag them.

Can you confirm the expected delivery ETA for the auditor report or substitute evidence? Also, please include the contact for Redwood Compliance so our security team can coordinate.

Best regards,
Sonia Patel
Data Protection Lead — Acme Energy
sonia.patel@acme-energy.com

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Audit rights & cross-border evidence request (Acme)

Team —

Acme (prospect) has asked for the following in advance of procurement sign-off:
- SOC2 or equivalent third-party auditor report (we have our latest SOC2 Type II report from Q1 2025)
- DPA (attached) + Article 28/30 records summary
- Subprocessor registry by country
- Transfer mechanisms (SCCs) + brief TIA
- DPIA summary / mapping to our controls

Can Legal/Trust confirm:
1) Any redlines in the attached DPA they expect from procurement?
2) Permissioning/boxed evidence for a third-party auditor to review — we should confirm scope and NDA if they spin up DataTrust as their auditor.

Rishi / Laura — can you assemble the package below and confirm who will be the single point of contact for Acme’s security team? I can respond to Sonia with ETA once we have a timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit rights & cross-border evidence request (Acme)

Jonas / team —

Thanks — we can put this package together. Plan below (ETA in business days):

1) Evidence package (2 business days):
   - Latest SOC2 Type II report (Q1 2025) — we have a redacted copy that we can provide under an NDA (stub: SOC2_Q1_2025_redacted.pdf).
   - DPA (attached) — Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf. Please note: procurement may seek changes around subprocessor notification timing; we will propose standard language.
   - Subprocessor registry — subprocessors_registry_2025-07.csv (will include country column).
   - Article 28/30 records summary — gdpr_art28_30_records.xlsx.

2) Transfers (3 business days):
   - Standard SCCs (we have template) and a short Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) summarizing legal basis and jurisdictions (deliverable: scc_template.pdf + tia_summary.pdf).

3) DPIA (3 business days):
   - DPIA summary and mapping to our controls (dpi_assessment_summary.pdf). If Acme requests deeper DPIA support we’ll schedule a short call with Product/Engineering.

4) Auditor coordination (1-2 business days to confirm scope):
   - If Acme uses DataTrust, we’ll require a scope of work and proof of accreditation; we can provide evidence to the auditor under a standard engagement and mutual NDA.

Action items:
- Laura: please prepare the redacted SOC2 and confirm any contractual redlines we should expect on the DPA.
- Monica: confirm subprocessors CSV includes hosting providers + third-party analytics by country.
- Jonas: hold response to Acme until we have an ETA (I’ll aim for end of day tomorrow for the list + SOC2 redacted).

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Legal & Privacy — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

---

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@acme-energy.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-energy.com, audit@datatrust.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Audit rights & cross-border evidence request (DPA / Article 28/30 records)

Thanks all — that plan works for us. A couple small notes:
- We will accept a redacted SOC2 Type II report and a scoped package for the auditor (DataTrust). I’ve cc'd DataTrust to start the SOW conversation.
- Please include a single Redwood POC for DataTrust to streamline logistics.
- For SCCs we usually expect the supplier to provide the template and a brief TIA; the draft will be reviewed by our legal team.

If you can confirm the ETA for the redacted SOC2 and the subprocessors CSV, procurement will tentatively allocate the next review slot on Friday, 25 July.

Regards,
Sonia

Attachment stubs referenced in thread: [SOC2_Q1_2025_redacted.pdf] [Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf] [subprocessors_registry_2025-07.csv] [gdpr_art28_30_records.xlsx] [dpi_assessment_summary.pdf]
